results.title: Chint Group - Wikipedia
results.content:
CHINT Group Co., Ltd. (Chint; Chinese: 正泰集团; pinyin: Zhèngtài Jítuán) is a Chinese holding company that focuses on low-voltage electrical appliances and photovoltaic products.

Its electrical appliance subsidiary is named Chint Electric and is currently listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

## Background

[edit] [...] Chint was one of the main sponsors involved in the creation of Wenzhou Minshang Bank, the first private bank in China. Nan would become its chairman. The bank started operations in March 2015.

By May 2024, Chint had expanded its business operations outside China covering over 100 countries and regions. Overseas business accounted for 30% of total revenue.

As of 2025, photovoltaic power stations have been a rapid growth point for Chint in recent years.

results.content: CHINT is a global leader in smart energy solutions, delivering efficient and sustainable power for industries, infrastructure, and communities worldwide. As one of CHINT’s core business segments, CHINT Electric focuses on low-voltage apparatus, high-voltage transmission and transformation, MV/LV integrated distribution, power automation, power electronics, energy services, wires and cables, instrumentation, and industrial automation, advancing toward integrated and digitalized solutions.
